from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(value == 5 for value in row))
    upper = [value for row in grid[:divider] for value in row if value not in (0, 5)]
    lower = [value for row in grid[divider + 1:] for value in row if value not in (0, 5)]
    colors = sorted(set(upper) | set(lower))
    counts_upper = {color: upper.count(color) for color in colors}
    counts_lower = {color: lower.count(color) for color in colors}
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda color: counts_lower[color] - counts_upper[color])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-9ee7e16a.py'
program_path.write_text(source)
